description: Step 3 - single-subject parcellation EM. All three variants supported with per-entry applies_to_variants gating.
source_note: `source` fields name the file owning the field's authoritative default. Line numbers are intentionally omitted — they drift on every reformat and the file/symbol name is the stable contract.
range_policy: advisory — `min`/`max` fields are UI hints documenting the values authors have validated; the parser/validator enforces only positivity (numeric fields), finiteness (float fields: NaN and Infinity are refused) and enum membership (enum fields). Out-of-range values that are positive and finite are accepted at parse time.

entries.description: step3 backend. 'cpu' is the numba session (VmfClusteringSession), the numerical reference. 'gpu' is the candidate-set EM on the theta support (VmfClusteringSessionSparseCUDA): BOLD stays bit-packed on device and the whole intra_em loop is device-resident.
entries.notes: 'gpu' contract: docs/step3_sparse_design.md; all three variants, run-to-run deterministic; MATLAB-reference agreement in its section 3. 'gpu' requires seed_mesh 'fsaverage3' in bold_inputs.json (the packed-BOLD kernels cap ceil(D/8) at 256); any other configuration is rejected at config / driver validation, so select backend_step3='cpu' for it.
Literal default is null; Step3Config.__post_init__ resolves it to 15.0 (gMSHBM), 0.0 (cMSHBM); dMSHBM never reads it. Explicit float overrides the variant default.
